title: 2.6.4 Control of Homeostasis
description: Negative and positive feedback mechanisms and the components of homeostatic control

questions.question: A feedback mechanism is a physiological regulation system that:
options: returns the body to its normal internal state
prevents the body from responding to any stimuli
questions.correctAnswer: returns the body to its normal internal state

questions.question: In a feedback mechanism, the receptor senses a change and sends a signal to the:
options: sensory organ in the skin tissue

questions.question: The control center generates a response that is signaled to an effector such as muscles or:
Negative feedback is a homeostatic process that:
options: reverses the direction of the stimulus
increases the deviation from normal levels
questions.correctAnswer: reverses the direction of the stimulus

questions.question: Positive feedback is a mechanism that:
options: accelerates a change in the body
reverses the direction of a stimulus
returns the body to its normal level
questions.correctAnswer: accelerates a change in the body

questions.question: The three basic components of a negative feedback system are the sensor, control center, and:
The sensor in a negative feedback system monitors the physiological value and reports to the:
An effector causes a change that reverses the situation and returns the value to the:
When body temperature rises above normal, the control center causes:
options: reduced blood flow to the skin

questions.question: When body temperature drops below normal, the body responds with:
options: increased blood flow to the skin

questions.question: Excessive sweating that removes heat through evaporation is called:
If heat loss is severe, the brain causes skeletal muscles to contract and produce:
As the body cools off, negative feedback halts the signaling process to:
A positive feedback loop would cause the body to:
options: keep sweating after it is no longer hot
stop sweating as soon as it cools
return quickly to the normal set point level
questions.correctAnswer: keep sweating after it is no longer hot
